observations: All four panels display nonnegative full Frobenius norms; separate massive, total radiation, and total stress labels are correct.

Radiation and total norms are abs of signed sums, not sums of norms.
z decreases from20 to2 left-to-right; small symlog linear regions retain zero/FP residuals; no data-floor substitution.
Prescribed UV/T, Case-A RR, electron-Thomson coupling and L8 conditional scope appear in title.
20 atomic charge-state populations plus neutron are tracked; electron panel explicitly uses algebraic charge closure.
H/D, He3/He4, Li6/Li7 charge indices and row/panel assignments match source array order.
FLRW line and 45-case min-max band are correctly labeled; a visually narrow band is not an assertion that all histories are identical.
T and n zero populations are declared initial-parent choices, not unavailable species substituted with zero.
Scaled abundance labels and shared electronic-rate assumption are explicit.
Signed component curves, sign of generated shear and cancellation 1-abs(Pm+Pr)/(abs(Pm)+abs(Pr)) are consistent with source.
The plotted opposing cases use requested Pm0=+/-5e-4, Pr0=-Pm0, S0=0; actual initial FP offsets are retained.
CMB photon and massless-neutrino signed stresses are separately displayed; radiation norm is not their sum of absolute values.
The near-overlap of the two cancellation curves does not imply exact sign symmetry.
P_nu is rendered as a single math label without the v1 Python newline defect.
Optical depth is explicitly accumulated fromz20 and is not optical depth toz0.
Temperature is marked prescribed; omitted thermal+ionization+UV energy is an instantaneous H^2 diagnostic, not a trajectory bound.
L8/L12 solid shear and dashed max common ell0..8 radiation-mode differences are both visible, including the larger high-mode discrepancy.
BDF/Radau is explicitly one FLRW comparison; log display floors are labeled.
Thomson on/off is explicitly a comparison of different physical models; no solver-accuracy inference is made.
Five 3x3 slices have x=signed Pr0 and y=signed Pm0, both increasing in the indicated directions.
Color encodes nonnegative endpoint Sigma(z2), while inputs are signed.
Two-line scientific labels are readable without overlap.
Every panel has its own color scale, explicitly disclosed; annotated values, not colors across panels, support quantitative comparison.
The FLRW-center residual 2.623e-21 is retained instead of forced tozero.

interpretation_constraints.HeIII_early_rise: The prescribed soft cohort contains60eV photons above54.42eV HeII threshold. An early HeIII rise under this input is not an inferred cosmic HeII-reionization epoch.

LiI_peak.interpretation: Conditional recombination/ionization response to declared LiII initial state and prescribed UV/T; not a measured or self-consistent cosmic lithium history.

interpretation_constraints.energy_diagnostic: The plotted eps_H2 uses saved thermal+ionization+prescribedUV energies relative to instantaneous critical-H energy. It is separate from the200eV-per-baryon diagnostic and does not bound missing reactions or full trajectories.
interpretation_constraints.model_scope: Non-tilted homogeneous LRS prescribedUV/T photo+Case-A RR trace-gas chemistry linked through algebraic ne to photon Thomson moments; not full thermochemical/nuclear/stars/UV-transport Einstein prediction.
